trap.label: set (sentidos)
trap.wrong: Set the table. Set a alarm for six. Set a goal. The story is set on Paris in 1920.
trap.right: Set the table. Set an alarm for six. Set a goal. The story is set in Paris in 1920.
trap.why: Em português “pôr a mesa”, “colocar despertador” e “ambientado em” usam verbos e preposições diferentes. O brasileiro esquece o artigo an e escolhe on em vez de in.

fix.wrong: The book is set on London.
fix.right: The book is set in London.

rewrite.answer: The story is set in Rio.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “We set a goal.” (They)
